title: French Senate blocks new crypto tax and wallet list critics called a kidnapping risk
content: The government opposed the measures citing existing EU data-sharing rules and non-legal tender status, leaving the 2027 budget open.

title: 'This time actually seems different': Crypto veterans brace for more pain as bitcoin tumbles
content: Crypto sentiment is near rock bottom, but Galaxy sees room for a deeper slide and even longtime crypto bulls are wary of buying amid fears of AI and quantum computing.

title: EU bank watchdog seeks European Commission rules for crypto firms offering DeFi lending
content: The EBA renewed its call for the commission to propose rules for crypto firms granting client access to DeFi, particularly lending protocols.

title: Ukrainian lawmakers pass crypto tax and regulation bill expected to bring in $330 million
content: Lawmaker Yaroslav Zhelezniak said he expects roughly $330 million (15 billion hryvnias) in added budget revenue, though the time frame remains unclear.

title: Crypto Long & Short: Bitcoin investors can’t keep ignoring Japan
content: Yen-funded carry trades ran an estimated $250 billion before the August 2024 selloff, and the Bank of Japan's policy rate is now around 1.25%. Phillip Lord of Bitcoin Japan explains how yen funding conditions reach bitcoin, and the shareholder test Japanese companies' bitcoin treasury strategies should have to pass.

title: Ethereum Foundation backs Keccak-256 to counter quantum, AI threats
content: Ethlabs co-founder Julian Ma told Cointelegraph that AI poses a more immediate threat as Ethereum prepares for one of its biggest security overhauls since the Merge.

title: US inflation rises to 3.8% ahead of December Fed meeting, clouding crypto outlook
content: US core inflation rose more than expected in October as markets anticipate a December interest rate hike, which could slow a crypto market recovery.

title: Bitcoin falls toward $57K amid US tariff fears, hot PCE data as Nasdaq drops 4%
content: The prospect of higher US tariffs and hotter-than-expected PCE inflation weighed on Bitcoin, crypto and stocks on Wednesday.

title: Nvidia agrees to $290M settlement over crypto mining revenue disclosures
content: The proposed settlement would resolve a shareholder lawsuit dating back to 2018 that alleged Nvidia misled investors about its exposure to the cryptocurrency industry.

title: FCC authorizes SpaceX to deploy 1M satellites for orbital AI data centers
content: The planned Starmind constellation will process data in orbit for use on Earth, as demand for artificial intelligence computing power continues to grow.

title: Nvidia to Pay $290 Million to Settle Long-Running Crypto Mining Revenue Lawsuit
content: The proposed cash settlement would resolve a shareholder suit alleging the chipmaker hid how much of its 2017-2018 gaming revenue came from crypto miners.

title: Elon Musk’s SpaceX Gets FCC Approval to Launch AI Data Centers in Space
content: The FCC authorized SpaceX’s solar-powered Starmind constellation, backing Elon Musk’s plans to move AI computing into orbit and reduce the industry’s dependence on increasingly strained power grids here on Earth.

title: OpenAI’s Changes to ChatGPT Could Drastically Cut Usage Limits for Paying Subscribers
content: OpenAI is merging ChatGPT’s Chat and Work modes, forcing advanced conversations to compete with coding tasks for usage and leaving paying subscribers wondering how much AI they will actually get.

title: Elon Musk’s X Wins Court Judgment Against Alleged Bitcoin Bot Farm Operators
content: London’s High Court entered a default judgment against Vivek Kumar Sen and Zamyang Sherpa after they failed to respond, though damages, which X estimates at over £207,000, won’t be set until a later hearing.

title: Bitcoin Falls Further as Inflation, Trump Tariffs and AI Selloff Rattle Markets
content: Bitcoin fell below $58,000 as stronger U.S. growth, accelerating inflation and proposed tariffs coincided with a renewed AI stock selloff and bets on higher interest rates in December and beyond.

title: Strategic Bitcoin Reserve Bill Clears House Committee, Heads to Floor
content: Bitcoin Magazine Strategic Bitcoin Reserve Bill Clears House Committee, Heads to Floor Rep. Nick Begich's bill to write the Strategic Bitcoin Reserve into law, with a 20-year ban on selling its bitcoin, is now eligible for a House floor vote. This post Strategic Bitcoin Reserve Bill Clears House Committee, Heads to Floor first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Switzerland Picks 57 Countries for Crypto Tax Data Sharing Starting in 2028
content: Bitcoin Magazine Switzerland Picks 57 Countries for Crypto Tax Data Sharing Starting in 2028 Switzerland approved 57 partner jurisdictions, including all EU states and the UK, for automatic crypto tax data exchanges under the OECD's CARF from 2028. This post Switzerland Picks 57 Countries for Crypto Tax Data Sharing Starting in 2028 first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Bithumb Says October Hack Exposed Passports, Bank Accounts and Wallet Addresses
content: Bitcoin Magazine Bithumb Says October Hack Exposed Passports, Bank Accounts and Wallet Addresses Bithumb said a follow-up review found its October breach exposed more people and data, including passports and wallet addresses, and lasted about 15 days. This post Bithumb Says October Hack Exposed Passports, Bank Accounts and Wallet Addresses first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: DOJ Targets 800 Defendants in Largest-Ever Scam Crackdown, Including Crypto Fraud
content: Bitcoin Magazine DOJ Targets 800 Defendants in Largest-Ever Scam Crackdown, Including Crypto Fraud The Justice Department said its largest-ever scam crackdown has targeted more than 800 defendants since March, with Southeast Asian crypto scam centers among its top targets. This post DOJ Targets 800 Defendants in Largest-Ever Scam Crackdown, Including Crypto Fraud first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: HRF Announces Funding of Seven Bitcoin Projects for People Living Under Authoritarian Regimes
content: Bitcoin Magazine HRF Announces Funding of Seven Bitcoin Projects for People Living Under Authoritarian Regimes HRF's Bitcoin Development Fund backed seven projects for self-custody, privacy and education under repression, from phone wallets to solar mining in Nigeria. This post HRF Announces Funding of Seven Bitcoin Projects for People Living Under Authoritarian Regimes first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
